items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: Joukowsky? What is his name? Kinda Heavisett? He played a big guitar. He played with, uh, oh, both of them

Oh, McClain was, you know, uh, what, what's the guitar player in the white bar? Joukowsky? What is his name? Kinda Heavisett? He played a big guitar.
